name: Counterfactual Variant 5
task:
Please complete the following four-stage scenario analysis task.

An e-book store sells 3 types: novels ($10, 100/month), textbooks ($50, 30/month), magazines ($5, 200/month). Author royalties: 30%. Platform fee: 15%. Calculate monthly net.

Increase marketing spend by 20% while keeping other factors constant. Calculate new net revenue.

Increase marketing spend by 20% AND increase average order value by 10%. Calculate new net revenue.

Compare the three scenarios. Recommend the best approach.
